project.description: New three-story residential building with three dwelling units. Zoning district RT-4. Standard Plan Review.
project.reviewer: Department of Buildings, first review cycle

comments.heading: Building
comments.text: Per 13-160, headroom at the rear stair landing under the third floor joists is not dimensioned. Show the headroom on the stair section and coordinate it with the framing plan.

comments.heading: Zoning
comments.text: The rear setback dimension on the site plan does not match the building footprint on the first floor plan. Reconcile the two sheets.

comments.heading: General
comments.text: The application lists the general contractor's license as pending. Provide the contractor's current license number.

comments.heading: General
comments.text: The door schedule does not show fire protection ratings for the unit entry doors that open onto the rear stair enclosure. Add the ratings.

comments.heading: General
comments.text: Note: review fees will be recalculated when the permit is issued. No response is needed.

comments.heading: General
comments.text: The sheet index on the title sheet omits S-501, which is included in the set. Correct the index.

expected.why: Title 13 was replaced; the current stair section is in 14B-10. Whether the framing works is the architect's call, and both named sheets change.
Which dimension is right is a design question, and either sheet may be the wrong one.
Only the contractor or owner has the license number.
Rating selection is a life-safety design decision. It is about fire protection, despite the General heading.
The letter says no response is needed.
A clerical index fix needs no design judgment, but it is still a sheet revision and gets marked like one.
